_loader_notes: Challenges with rolling starts (AGENTS.md H8, replaces S9's fixed dates). There are no start_date or end_date fields: each participant picks next Monday or the 1st of next month when she joins, stored on challenge_participants (add start_date there).
No countdown timers anywhere. Never tie a challenge to a discount or a deadline.
show_participant_count is false. Only switch it on once counts are real and meaningful.
Each week's mission is checked from logged data (requirement). Weeks run Monday to Sunday from her start date.

Gentle catch-up: if a week's mission isn't met, that week simply repeats (the challenge extends by a week), up to 2 times. After that the challenge ends quietly with no failure message, and she can rejoin any time. Copy: 'This week didn't go to plan. No problem, we'll pick it up next week.'
One active challenge at a time keeps Home simple. Joining a new one asks to leave the current one.
Challenges run alongside any routine. Sessions count towards the challenge, the weekly target and the streak at the same time.
Completion awards the existing 'challenge-complete' badge (achievements.json) once per challenge, plus a share card (numbers and challenge name only).
Requirement types: sessions (count may be 'weekly_target'), stretch_sessions, new_exercises, new_equipment. 'New' means first time ever logged in Ascenda.
featured_window controls when a challenge is pushed on Home; all active challenges are always browsable in Programmes.

challenges.name: Four Weeks Strong
challenges.summary: Three sessions a week for four weeks. Build the habit that makes everything else easier.
challenges.description: This is the classic Ascenda challenge. Train three times a week for four weeks, using your current routine or any sessions you like. Strength, stretch sessions of 10 minutes or more and (once they arrive) cardio sessions all count. If your plan has two training days a week, your target is two.

weekly_missions.title: Set the tone
weekly_missions.body: Get your sessions done this week. Plan them in the Planner first so the decision's already made.

weekly_missions.title: Keep it going
weekly_missions.body: Same again. Notice how much easier it is to start this week.

weekly_missions.title: Halfway and beyond
weekly_missions.body: This is the week habits are made. Pick your training times and stick to them.

weekly_missions.title: Finish strong
weekly_missions.body: Last week. Make it count, then look back at everything you did.

completion.title: Four Weeks Strong: complete
completion.body: Four weeks, {sessions} sessions. That's a habit.

challenges.name: The Gym Explorer
challenges.summary: Try one new thing each week and make more of the gym feel like yours.
challenges.description: Each week has one small mission: a new exercise, a new machine or a new area of the gym. Use the first-time guides and "if it's taken" swaps to make each one easy. Everything you try counts towards Gym unlocked.
challenges.audience: Anyone who wants to feel at home in more of the gym

weekly_missions.title: One new exercise
weekly_missions.body: Log one exercise you've never done in Ascenda before. Open its guide first if you'd like.

weekly_missions.title: Try a machine
weekly_missions.body: Log an exercise on a machine you haven't used yet, like the leg press, lat pulldown or seated row.

weekly_missions.title: The cable station
weekly_missions.body: Try a cable exercise, like a cable row, face pull or kickback. The guide shows you how to set it up.

weekly_missions.title: Into the free weights
weekly_missions.body: Log a dumbbell, kettlebell or barbell exercise you haven't done before.

challenges.fallback_note: If she has already used every machine or cable exercise, the mission becomes 'any new exercise' so nobody is stuck.

completion.title: The Gym Explorer: complete
completion.body: {new_exercises} new exercises and {new_equipment} new pieces of kit. The gym's getting smaller.

challenges.name: 28 Days of Stretch
challenges.summary: Three stretch sessions a week for four weeks. Feel looser, calmer and ready to train.
challenges.description: Do three stretch sessions of 10 minutes or more each week. They count towards your weekly target and streak too. Mix them in on rest days, after a session or in the evening.
challenges.audience: Everyone, especially if you feel stiff or stressed

weekly_missions.title: Start gently
weekly_missions.body: Try three different stretch sessions to find the ones you like. Morning mobility and Wind down are good places to start.

weekly_missions.title: Hips and back
weekly_missions.body: Include Happy hips or Back unwind this week.

weekly_missions.title: After training
weekly_missions.body: Do at least one stretch session on a day you train, like After leg day.

weekly_missions.title: The full flow
weekly_missions.body: Finish with the 20-minute Full body recovery flow as one of your three.

completion.title: 28 Days of Stretch: complete
completion.body: {stretch_sessions} stretch sessions and {stretch_minutes} minutes of looking after yourself.

challenges.name: Quiet Start
challenges.summary: Two calm sessions a week for four weeks, all in one spot. The gentlest way to begin.
challenges.description: Made for your first month in the gym, or your first month back. Two sessions a week using a bench and a pair of dumbbells in a quieter corner. No machines to find, no queues, just you and your plan.
challenges.audience: New to the gym or coming back after a break

weekly_missions.title: Your first spot
weekly_missions.body: Do two sessions. Your first gym session is a great place to start.

weekly_missions.title: Same spot, more confidence
weekly_missions.body: Two sessions again. Try going a little heavier on one exercise if it felt easy.

weekly_missions.title: Make it yours
weekly_missions.body: Two sessions. Add a note to one exercise, like which bench or dumbbells you like.

weekly_missions.title: Look back
weekly_missions.body: Two sessions to finish. Then see how much has changed in a month.

completion.title: Quiet Start: complete
completion.body: A month of showing up. You're not new any more.

featured_window.note: Feature on Home in January and February (new year starts). Available all year in Programmes.
